name: WFMU Independent Freeform Music Director Physical Review Route
country: Global / United States independent freeform radio
feeAmount: Free-first/manual physical review route. Official WFMU guidance asks music review packages to be mailed to the Music Director; no payment route was observed.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for physical package preparation, clean/radio edit choice, one-sheet, release context, postage, editorial-fit review and no-guarantee airplay expectations. No package was prepared or mailed and no outbound message was sent.
notes: Official WFMU guidance identifies WFMU as an independent freeform radio station, shows active current playlists/archives and provides a Send Us Music package route to the Music Director. Queued manual because it is a physical-review workflow.

name: Soho Radio London Music Submission Email Contact Form Route
feeAmount: Free-first/manual public email/form route. Official Soho Radio contact guidance lists a dedicated Music submission email and a contact form; no payment route was observed.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for track-link selection, pitch copy, release timing, genre/show fit, contact-form/cookie-consent handling, press assets and anti-spam compliance. No email, contact form or music link was submitted.
notes: Official Soho Radio contact page lists the public music-submission address music@sohoradiolondon.com plus general contact routes and shows recent July 2026 programming activity. Queued manual because editorial fit and outreach copy must be reviewed.

name: NTS Radio Show Proposal Audio Link Public Form Route
feeAmount: Free-first/manual public form route. Official NTS contact guidance exposes a Radio Show Proposal form that asks for proposal text and audio links; no payment route was observed.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required because this is a radio-show proposal path rather than a generic track drop. It requires concept, host/artist context, audio links, biography, rights review, schedule fit, city/identity details and editorial-positioning copy. No form was submitted and no audio links were delivered.
notes: Official NTS contact page includes a Radio Show Proposal workflow with fields for proposal copy and up to three SoundCloud, Mixcloud or YouTube links. Queued manual as an authorized but editorial public-form route.

name: Spinnin Records Talent Pool Login Demo Upload Route
feeAmount: Free-first/manual login route. Official Talent Pool guidance asks users to create an account or log in to upload a track; no payment/pricing requirement was observed.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account/login boundary, unreleased-demo suitability, electronic-label fit, file/link choice, rights, metadata, profile setup and platform terms. No account was created, no login was used and no track was uploaded.
notes: Official Spinnin Records Talent Pool shows an account-gated upload path and active 2026 platform context; contact guidance routes track submissions to Talent Pool. Queued manual because login and rightsholder declarations are artist-controlled.

manualReviewReason: Owner review required for paid plan selection, account creation, release metadata, DSP territory settings, audio/artwork quality, copyright ownership, ISRC/UPC decisions, payout setup, royalty terms and release timing. notes: Official Amuse pages validate an active 2026 distribution/app route with paid plans, major-store distribution, artist services and current newsroom activity. Queued manual because it is an authenticated paid release workflow.
